review_method: Visual inspection of all eight complete PDF pages and enlarged revision blocks using PyMuPDF 1.24.14. Text extraction was sparse or empty for seven maps; no OCR-based parcel matching was used.
scope: Publication, municipal context, printed dates and selected map labels only; not georeferencing or exhaustive parcel validation.
